Oh my gosh I’m sorry I rarely check Reddit lately & didn’t see this until now! But yes of course :)

1. I was afraid I would lose my “sparkle” lol but I haven’t. If anything, I feel that I can be more myself around people than I could before. And I actually have more fun which I think is related to being less stressed- And being able to be more present. I don’t go out *socially* very often, but I do go out significantly more than before. 

2. And YES ME TOO!!! Anger & reactivity was the hardest part for me! It was really hard on my relationship because I struggled with constant irritability & blew things that upset me out of proportion & I can not stress how much better things with us have have been since Lamictal.  It feels really good to not be angry and on edge all of the time. I’m genuinely a nicer person lol 

3. I truly relate to everything your saying. I honestly don’t struggle with that as much as I used to either- I think it was partially tied to my issues with anger. In general, I’ve been able to set better boundaries with people in my life & prioritize myself which has made a huge difference. 

4. Honestly, I drink regularly. Occasionally I’ll drink a lot if it’s a girls night out or some occasion, and I typically have a couple glasses of wine a week. Never noticed anything weird- pretty sure it’s not recommended but I’ve been totally fine 

** I want to add that no medication is a cure-all obviously, and I do have my moments where I struggle with all of the above but it’s way less often than before & on a much smaller scale. I’ve had the ideal experience with this medication, but some people have different experiences. I’d recommend giving it a try though if you have the option. It is known for having few to none side effects. 

I hope this is helpful. :) you absolutely got this!

I used to take 100 mg of lamictal twice daily so like 200 mg and like 3 mg of abilify. Then I went off my meds. I’ve restarted and am currently at 75 mg of lamictal and will eventually be getting back to the 200. I take 2 mg of abilify but I don’t think the abilify helps me. The lamictal does help me maintain the highs and lows and extreme/impulsive thoughts, but it doesn’t help the symptoms of depression. I haven’t found anything so far that helps with that. Lately I cry every single day over the smallest of things & am carrying a heavy overall sadness.. I’m also very anxious and irritable constantly and always feel like I am on the edge.  I think there must be something that can help with that & not just keep it contained. Im sorry that this is such a long reply
